design_note: GDS adaptation using Sinc-modulated priors and a Normal(theta,1) working likelihood. It is not an exact replication of Li and Rice. Generated observations are independent across i; the heteroscedastic scenario uses iid random covariate-outcome pairs.
experiment: GDS expanded Sinc-prior Bayesian robust-inference stress grid
reference: Li and Rice (2024), Statistical Science 39(4), 589-600, DOI 10.1214/24-STS935
